ballpark.pick: Which ballpark do the {label} call home?
ballpark.statement: The {label} play their home games at {value}.
ballpark.reverse: Which MLB team plays its home games at {value}?
ballpark.match: Match each MLB team to its home ballpark.

rows.label: New York Yankees
rows.description: baseball team and Major League Baseball franchise in the Bronx, New York, United States
rows.hook: has won more World Series titles than any other franchise and wears famous pinstripes

rows.label: Los Angeles Dodgers
rows.description: Major League Baseball franchise in Los Angeles, California
rows.hook: moved west from Brooklyn after Jackie Robinson broke baseball's color barrier with it

rows.label: Los Angeles Angels
rows.description: baseball team and Major League Baseball franchise in Anaheim, California, United States
rows.hook: was first owned by a famous singing cowboy actor and is home to slugger Mike Trout

rows.label: Athletics
rows.description: baseball team and Major League Baseball franchise in Sacramento, California, United States
rows.hook: inspired the book and film Moneyball with its budget-minded way of building a roster

rows.label: Boston Red Sox
rows.description: baseball team and Major League Baseball franchise in Boston, Massachusetts, United States
rows.hook: broke a long title drought that was blamed on a curse tied to Babe Ruth

rows.label: Cleveland Guardians
rows.description: baseball team and Major League Baseball franchise in Cleveland, Ohio
rows.hook: took a new name inspired by stone statues on a local bridge after retiring its old nickname

rows.label: Milwaukee Brewers
rows.description: baseball team and Major League Baseball franchise in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, United States
rows.hook: has a slide-riding mascot and racing sausages at its games

rows.label: New York Mets
rows.description: baseball team and Major League Baseball franchise in Queens, New York, United States
rows.hook: shocked the sport with a famous "Miracle" championship as lovable underdogs

rows.label: Toronto Blue Jays
rows.description: baseball team and Major League Baseball franchise in Toronto, Ontario, Canada
rows.hook: became the first team based outside the United States to win the World Series

rows.label: Chicago Cubs
rows.description: baseball team and Major League Baseball franchise in Chicago, Illinois, United States
rows.hook: went more than a century without a championship before finally breaking a famous curse

rows.label: Chicago White Sox
rows.description: baseball team and Major League Baseball franchise in Chicago, Illinois, United States
rows.hook: swept the World Series to end a championship drought of nearly nine decades

rows.label: Tampa Bay Rays
rows.description: baseball team and Major League Baseball franchise in St. Petersburg, Florida, United States
rows.hook: plays under a fixed roof and has reached the World Series despite a tiny payroll

rows.label: Atlanta Braves
rows.description: Major League Baseball team in Cumberland, Georgia
rows.hook: was the team Hank Aaron played for when he broke Babe Ruth's career home run record

rows.label: San Francisco Giants
rows.description: baseball team and Major League Baseball franchise in San Francisco, California, United States
rows.hook: sees home runs splash into a bay beyond right field and once employed Willie Mays

rows.label: Philadelphia Phillies
rows.description: Major League Baseball franchise in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania
rows.hook: has a big furry green mascot and is among the sport's oldest franchises

rows.label: San Diego Padres
rows.description: Major League Baseball franchise in San Diego, California, United States
rows.hook: is named for Spanish missionaries and is known for brown and yellow uniforms

rows.label: Seattle Mariners
rows.description: baseball team and Major League Baseball franchise in Seattle, Washington, United States
rows.hook: employed Ichiro when he set the single-season record for hits

rows.label: Detroit Tigers
rows.description: baseball team and Major League Baseball franchise in Detroit, Michigan, United States of America
rows.hook: wears a cap with an Old English D and has Ty Cobb in its history

rows.label: Baltimore Orioles
rows.description: baseball team and Major League Baseball franchise in Baltimore, Maryland, United States
rows.hook: was Cal Ripken Jr.'s only team when he broke Lou Gehrig's record for consecutive games

rows.label: Houston Astros
rows.description: Major League Baseball franchise in Houston, Texas
rows.hook: played the first major-league games under a dome, in a building billed as the eighth wonder of the world

rows.label: St. Louis Cardinals
rows.description: Major League Baseball franchise in St. Louis, Missouri
rows.hook: has won more World Series titles than any other National League team

rows.label: Cincinnati Reds
rows.description: professional baseball team in Cincinnati, Ohio, United States
rows.hook: was the first openly all-professional club, with Johnny Bench catching in its 1970s glory days

rows.label: Miami Marlins
rows.description: baseball team and Major League Baseball franchise in Miami, Florida, United States
rows.hook: won two World Series as a wild card team without ever winning its division

rows.label: Colorado Rockies
rows.description: Major League Baseball franchise in Denver, Colorado, United States
rows.hook: plays a mile above sea level, where thin air helps fly balls travel farther

rows.label: Pittsburgh Pirates
rows.description: baseball team and Major League Baseball franchise in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, United States
rows.hook: won a World Series on a walk-off home run by Bill Mazeroski in game seven

rows.label: Arizona Diamondbacks
rows.description: baseball team and Major League Baseball franchise in Phoenix, Arizona, United States
rows.hook: won a World Series in only its fourth season, beating the Yankees

rows.label: Minnesota Twins
rows.description: baseball team and Major League Baseball franchise in Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States
rows.hook: is named for a pair of neighbouring cities on the Mississippi River

rows.label: Kansas City Royals
rows.description: baseball team and Major League Baseball franchise in Kansas City, Missouri, United States
rows.hook: won the World Series after a long playoff absence, beating the Mets in five games
